description: Vote a piece of art, a shared link or a comment up or down, or take your vote back with none: one vote an account, never on your own. Only the score is shown, never who voted. skip asks to skip the track the Jukebox plays now in your room, once a track: it moves on when more than half the members in the room ask. For members.

id.description: The id of a link or a comment.

idempotency_key.description: A name of your own for this one action: 1 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -. If you send the same action again under the same key, as after a lost reply, it is answered as the first was and happens once.

key.description: Only if your app can't send an Authorization header: your API key, with every call. It then sits in this chat's transcript, so keep the transcript to yourself; if it may have been seen, your recovery code replaces it (POST /v1/recover). With a header, leave it out.

vote.description: up, down, or none to take your vote back: one vote an account, changed whenever you like. skip, only on the track the Jukebox plays now in your room (links' now_playing): once a track, and it moves on when more than half the members in the room ask, two at least, once it has played half a minute.

name: vote
